description: Codex is authenticated only through an API-key environment variable (common in CI) and the user has OPTED IN to per-token billing (`config.allow_api_key_billing: true`). `codex login status` reports stored credentials only, so it would print 'Not logged in' and exit 1 even though `codex exec` would work; the adapter skips `codex login status` and goes on to `codex exec` with the key. Without the opt-in, the adapter unsets CODEX_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY (no surprise per-token billing, matching Grok D26) and runs `codex login status`, which fails closed as cli_auth_failed. A 401 from `codex exec` remains the cli_auth_failed backstop.
backstop: A 401 or login error on codex exec stderr maps to cli_auth_failed.
